row:
Medical Channel Asia (MCA) was started with the mission of helping information-seekers cut through the clutter online and provide credible, researched and useful health information. 

Our commitment is to provide timely and regular health information and news specifically catered to the global Asian audience. The content provided in MCA is designed to be most suited for the Asian context and body-type. All content is developed by a medically-trained editorial team in consultation with licensed healthcare practitioners from around the world. 

All content provided on MCA is meant for informational purposes only and not as a substitute for personal health and medical advice from a healthcare professional.
